name: 黃千溥
objective:
This course introduces graduate students to core construction management functions — scope, contract, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and change — through a systematic knowledge-modeling approach that structures tacit, fragmented construction knowledge into traceable, executable, and auditable forms, improving management efficiency and decision reliability. The course culminates in an integrated final project and two flexible weeks exploring AI tools for project collaboration.

本課程以系統性知識建模方法，帶領研究生掌握範疇、合約、時程、成本、品質、風險、變更等營建管理核心職能，將隱性、破碎的營建知識轉化為可追溯、可執行、可稽核的結構，提升管理效率與決策可靠性。課程以整合型期末專題收尾，並於彈性學習週探索 AI 工具於專案協同作業之應用。

1. Course introduction and knowledge management in construction. (Week 1)
2. Stakeholder and project scope management. (Weeks 2-3)
3. Contract management and scheduling. (Weeks 4-5)
4. Cost estimation and budget control. (Week 6)
5. Case study and practical project analysis. (Week 7)
6. Quality management and risk assessment. (Weeks 8-9)
7. Change order and claims management. (Week 10)
8. Communication, coordination, and project closeout. (Weeks 11-12)
9. Final project development and analysis. (Weeks 13-14)
10. Artificial intelligence applications and final presentations. (Weeks 15-16)
11. Flexible Learning: AI tools for project management collaboration. (Weeks 17-18)
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Course introduction — knowledge management challenges in construction.
Week 2: Stakeholder and organizational role management.
Week 3: Project charter and scope definition.
Week 4: Contract management and clause structuring.
Week 5: Scheduling and progress control (CPM).
Week 6: Cost estimation and budget traceability.
Week 7: Case study and special topic practice.
Week 8: Quality management and inspection systems.
Week 9: Risk management and engineering insurance.
Week 10: Change order and claims management.
Week 11: Communication and site coordination.
Week 12: Project closeout and warranty handover.
Week 13: Final project topic development.
Week 14: Final project integrated analysis.
Week 15: Artificial intelligence applications in construction.
Week 16: Final presentations and peer review.
Week 17: AI tools for project collaboration.
Week 18: Collaborative AI and knowledge consolidation.
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Weeks 17–18 focus on exploring AI tools for construction project management, emphasizing AI-supported team collaboration (knowledge sharing, task allocation, progress synchronization). Using pre-recorded materials with blended learning, students apply what they learn to collaboratively refine the course's shared knowledge base.

第 17-18 週聚焦營建專案管理 AI 工具探索，著重 AI 於跨團隊協同作業（知識共享、任務分派、進度同步）之應用。採預錄數位教材搭配混成學習，學生自主學習後應用於課程知識庫之協同建置與精進。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Each student records a 5–10 minute narrated presentation (English slides, narration in either language) on applying AI tools to construction collaboration, uploaded to YouTube. Submit a 500-word peer-review reflection on at least 3 classmates' videos. The most-liked video earns 3 bonus points (not counted within the 10%).

每位學生製作 5-10 分鐘投影片簡報（投影片為英文，口說中英文皆可），錄音後上傳 YouTube，主題為 AI 工具於營建協同作業之應用。並繳交 500 字同儕心得，回饋至少 3 位同學作品。全班互評按讚數最高者加 3 分（不計入 10% 配分）。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          The learning outcomes from the flexible learning weeks (Weeks 17–18) account for 10% of the final course grade, assessed on presentation completeness, quality of the English slides, clarity of oral delivery, and the specificity of peer-review reflections. An additional 3-point bonus (not counted within the 10%) is awarded to the presentation receiving the most peer likes.

彈性學習週（17-18 週）之學習成果占學期總成績 10%，依簡報內容完整度、英文投影片品質、口語表達清晰度，以及同儕互評心得之具體性綜合評分；另設 3 分加分項，獎勵全班互評按讚數最高之簡報作品，加分項不計入原 10% 配分內。

scorePolicy:
Weekly assignments, class participation, final project, and presentation, evaluated by knowledge-modeling rubric and research-report quality.

每週作業、課堂參與、期末專題與發表，依知識建模評分規準與研究小論文品質綜合評定。
materials:
This course uses no single textbook. Materials consist of instructor-developed knowledge-modeling framework notes, weekly readings from international journals (Automation in Construction, Advanced Engineering Informatics) and conferences (ISARC, i3CE), supplemented by an instructor-created setup guide, final-project scaffolding worksheet, and grading rubric.

本課程無指定教科書，教材以授課教師自編之知識建模框架講義、每週對應之國際期刊論文（Automation in Construction、Advanced Engineering Informatics 及 ISARC、i3CE 研討會論文）為主，並提供自編之課前環境建置指南、期末專題引導工作表、評分規準等補充教材。
consultation: Students may contact the instructor via email for course-related questions, and may book office hours for individual consultation. 如有課程相關問題，請以電子郵件聯繫授課教師，並可預約 Office Hour 進行個別討論。
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
